datetime_convention: October 2026 UTC, each day at 12:00. Validity end is exclusive.

families.symptom: wireless gateway reports duplicate address leases after roaming
families.instruction_a: Inspect the DHCP lease history before resetting the radio.
families.instruction_b: Compare the gateway reservation map before resetting the radio.

families.symptom: artifact mirror serves a build with an unexpected checksum
families.instruction_a: Validate the build provenance before clearing the mirror cache.
families.instruction_b: Compare the signed release manifest before clearing the mirror cache.

families.symptom: service desk ingestion retries the same support envelope continuously
families.instruction_a: Trace the envelope deduplication key before replaying the envelope.
families.instruction_b: Check the retry ledger before replaying the envelope.

families.symptom: batch worker broker shows a growing queue of accepted jobs
families.instruction_a: Inspect consumer checkpoints before reassigning waiting jobs.
families.instruction_b: Verify the dispatch watermark before reassigning waiting jobs.

families.symptom: certificate monitor signals a renewal while the endpoint still reports the current chain
families.instruction_a: Inspect the probe certificate chain before closing the alert.
families.instruction_b: Compare the renewal inventory before closing the alert.

families.symptom: log relay queue reports delayed forwarding but uplink remains healthy
families.instruction_a: Compare the relay cursor before pausing forwarding.
families.instruction_b: Check the forwarder batch sequence before pausing forwarding.

families.symptom: identity reconciler shows stale directory membership after a sync
families.instruction_a: Compare the directory sync cursor before starting another reconciliation.
families.instruction_b: Inspect the membership event ledger before starting another reconciliation.

families.symptom: snapshot index omits the latest scheduled storage backup
families.instruction_a: Review the backup catalog digest before attempting a restore.
families.instruction_b: Compare the snapshot job record before attempting a restore.

families.symptom: telemetry ingress shows accepted events without corresponding sample counts
families.instruction_a: Compare ingress batch IDs before recycling the receiver.
families.instruction_b: Inspect the sampling job summary before recycling the receiver.

families.symptom: alert routing fans out duplicate notifications for one service event
families.instruction_a: Compare the alert fingerprints before changing the delivery policy.
families.instruction_b: Review the route audit before changing the delivery policy.
